message.content: Starting triage on the reported pole failure — shrinking the scenario to isolate the cause.
Shrink isolated a minimal case — now confirming it reproduces reliably.
Replay confirmed — now inspecting the failure and the steps leading to it.
At the violating step the pole is well past the limit — checking earlier states to trace the divergence.
Early signs point to sensor noise — gathering a few more snapshots to test that.
Initial state is nominal — sampling mid-run to pinpoint when control is lost.
Mid-run already shows large velocities building — checking a step just before the violation to complete the picture.
Noise looks like the destabilizing factor — running a clean comparison to verify.
